# Solana Wallet x402

Built by falcon.sol: anon dev shipping pay-per-call data tools and x402 APIs for builders and agents. X: https://x.com/ygfalcon · GitHub: https://github.com/ygfalcon · Apify: https://apify.com/falcon-sol

> Pay-per-call Solana wallet intelligence. Agents pay USDC over x402 on Solana or Base. An unpaid call returns HTTP 402. accepts[].amount is USDC base units (6 decimals).

## Paid

- [Solana wallet profile](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/wallet/profile): $0.009 USDC (9000 base units). Use this when you need priced holdings and windowed PnL for one Solana wallet. Holdings valued in USD, a short plain-language summary, windowed realized and unrealized PnL, win rate, and evidence-backed labels such as active memecoin trader. txLimit is an integer from 5 to 25 and defaults to 20. Call free wallet_preview first if you only need SOL balance and last-active time, or wallet_quick for a cheaper copy-trade screen. Required query: address. Optional query: txLimit. MCP tool `wallet_profile`.
- [Trending Solana tokens](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/token/trending): $0.0018 USDC (1800 base units). Use this when you need the Solana tokens traders are watching right now. Trending Solana tokens with liquidity, 24h volume, pair age, and a short summary. Each token includes holder concentration (top-10 share), mint and freeze authority, LP lock or burn status, and sniper or bundle share of early supply. Risky results are plain-English risk flags. Thin, new, and wash-like books are ranked down. limit is an integer from 1 to 25 and defaults to 15. No required query. Optional query: limit. MCP tool `token_trending`.
- [Wallet funding source and cluster](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/wallet/funding): $0.009 USDC (9000 base units). Use this when you need a wallet's first SOL funder and whether other wallets look like the same operator. Find a wallet's first SOL funder, flag wallets that share that funder or a CEX deposit address, and return a cluster id with plain-language sybil risk reasons. Labeled exchange hot wallets are not used as a cluster. Optional peers compares up to 8 other wallets. Required query: address. Optional query: peers. MCP tool `wallet_funding`.
- [Solana wallet quick screen](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/wallet/quick): $0.002 USDC (2000 base units). Use this for a cheap copy-trade screen before paying for a full profile. Cheap copy-trade screen for one wallet: windowed realized PnL, win rate, closed trades, last active time, and bot, exchange, net-winner and dormant flags. Free teaser at /wallet/preview; full report at /wallet/profile. Required query: address. MCP tool `wallet_quick`.
- [Batch quick screen, up to 10 wallets](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/wallet/quick/batch): $0.015 USDC (15000 base units). Quick screen (windowed realized PnL, win rate, bot, exchange, net-winner and dormant flags) for up to 10 Solana wallets in one paid call, ranked by realized PnL. Pass addresses comma-separated. Required query: addresses. MCP tool `wallet_quick_batch`.

## Free

- [Wallet preview](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/wallet/preview): free SOL balance, last active time and 24h transaction count. Required query: address. No payment. MCP tool `wallet_preview`. Free teaser. Call this before any paid wallet tool. Returns SOL balance, last active time, how many transactions landed in the last 24 hours, and a dormant or recently-active label. Does not spend USDC. Pass one base58 Solana address. Invalid addresses return an error and do not ask for payment. Upgrade to wallet_quick for a copy-trade screen, wallet_profile for priced holdings, or wallet_funding for the first SOL funder and cluster.
- [Health](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/health): free freshness and SLA. Reports version, p50 and p95 latency over a rolling window, upstream RPC rate-limit status, and cache age. No payment. The same sla object is on /.well-known/x402.
- [OpenAPI](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/openapi.json): machine-readable API with x-payment-info on paid routes and the health SLA schema.
- [x402 discovery](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/.well-known/x402): prices, accepts, input schemas, facilitator URLs, and the live SLA snapshot.
- [MCP](https://solana-wallet-intel-phi.vercel.app/mcp): POST JSON-RPC. GET returns 405. Tools `wallet_profile`, `token_trending`, `wallet_funding`, `wallet_quick`, `wallet_quick_batch`, plus free `wallet_preview` and `ping`. Every tool is read-only.

## Which call to make

- Call `wallet_preview` first when you need SOL balance, last active time, or a 24h transaction count. It is free.
- Call `wallet_quick` ($0.002) for a copy-trade screen: realized PnL, win rate, closed trades, and bot, exchange, net-winner, and dormant flags.
- Call `wallet_quick_batch` ($0.015) to screen up to 10 wallets in one paid call, ranked by realized PnL. `addresses` is 1 to 10 comma-separated base58 addresses.
- Call `wallet_profile` ($0.009) for priced holdings, windowed PnL, and evidence-backed labels. `txLimit` is an integer from 5 to 25 and defaults to 20.
- Call `wallet_funding` ($0.009) for the first SOL funder and a sybil cluster. `peers` compares up to 8 other wallets.
- Call `token_trending` ($0.0018) for trending Solana tokens with plain-English risk flags. `limit` is an integer from 1 to 25 and defaults to 15.

An unpaid call to a paid route returns HTTP 402 even when address, addresses, txLimit, limit, or peers is missing or invalid. After a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is attached, a bad query returns HTTP 400 and is not charged. Settlement is cancelled when a paid route returns a non-2xx status.

Responses include `cached`, `stale`, and `cacheAgeMs`. `stale: true` means a previous result was returned while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. Paid responses are `Cache-Control: private, no-store` so a shared CDN cannot skip payment. The free preview may be cached briefly at the edge.

## Pricing note

GET /token/trending costs $0.0018 (1800 base units). That price includes holder concentration (top-10 share), mint and freeze authority, LP lock or burn status, and sniper or bundle share of early supply. Each risky result is a plain-English risk flag. The checks are read from free public Solana RPCs. When a check cannot be read, the response says so.

Pay with an x402 client (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE) or the official MCP payment wrapper. Settlement is cancelled when the route returns a non-2xx error.
